notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
After our studio have celebrated Hanukkah, we have started the process of developing the New Year's Update. And now the Standing Man has received:

[list]
[*]Improved optimization (it is possible to use the slider to adjust the number of messages on the map);
[*]Additional achievement "Overmind".
[/list]

Enjoy folks!

AG

notes.title: Sha Uu Yeah!
notes.content: Thanks to all players who played our game!

notes.title: Man Standing is now available!
notes.content:
With big honor we announce that our masterpiece has been released!
Long live the youth who will follow the vanguard of modernity of a new meaning and forms!

With love Alfina Gamers.

notes.title: Changing the release date
notes.content: Art requires sacrifice, and in this case, the sacrifice is time. With regret we should report that the release has to be reschedule on December 11 for a reasons beyond of our control.We are hope for your understanding. Truly yours Alfina Gamers
